---
title: "Research"
---

My research primarily focuses on identifying the conditions under which
humans can effectively work together with AI systems - delegating tasks between themselves and AI, 
or providing and consuming AI-assisted advice. 

Motivated by current regulatory demands,  I particularly focus on the implications of providing explanations 
of an  AI's prediction logic (*explainable AI, XAI*) on the human user's beliefs, (meta-)cognitive processes, trust and decision-making. In a second strand of my research, my co-authors and I 
test the effectiveness of evidence-based behavioral interventions in motivating debt repayment behavior. 

Across my projects, I design and implement theory-driven and incentivized behavioral experiments (online, lab-in-the-field or natural field experiments) and large-scale surveys -- often in collaboration
with industry partners in various sectors (real estate, banking, fintech).
